charts.name: ubcc-metric1-capacity-latency
charts.metric_definition: Capacity ratio and increase use the final Metric1 capacity contract; latency is independently defined as mean(all completed spill Outer) - mean(all completed ideal Outer).

evidence_sets.name: capacity
evidence_sets.aggregation: per-role capacity, then spill / naive; optimized support runs are excluded

evidence_sets.name: outer_latency
evidence_sets.aggregation: per-repeat completed-Outer mean difference, then equal-weight mean

charts.cross_set_weighting: none; the two evidence sets serve independent Metric1 subcontracts

charts.name: ubcc-ha-vi-comparison
charts.metric_definition: Historical 2N1S/P100 only: HA-VI group mean / UBCC group mean speedup under original formal weights, not GM. Reference=1. New multi-topology P100 gate blocked; N/A, no missing-case weighting.

charts.name: ubcc-tc120-124-scenarios
charts.metric_definition: Scenario change reductions; visual-only preview derived from the checked-in preview data.

charts.name: ubcc-tc130-134-pressure
charts.metric_definition: Pressure path reductions; visual-only preview derived from the checked-in preview data.

charts.name: ubcc-metric3-per-tc-reductions
charts.metric_definition: Historical 2N1S/P100 per-TC speedup=1/(1-reduction_pct/100), plus equal-TC GM. Reference=1. Single-topology coverage only; new multi-topology P100 N/A.

charts.name: ubcc-metric1-extension-matrix
charts.metric_definition: 2026-09-06–08 selected PASS extension; capacity=spill effective/naive; Delta=(completed Outer spill mean-ideal mean)*2 cycles@2GHz; application=naive/spill-noopt mean-plane E2E ns/op. P175/P200 are directory pressure, not L3 pressure. GM within TC then across TC; Delta uses AM then AM. Oversized reference is not Formal IdealDir.

charts.name: ubcc-tc142-147-applications
charts.metric_definition: 2026-09-06–08 selected PASS extension; capacity=spill effective/naive; Delta=(completed Outer spill mean-ideal mean)*2 cycles@2GHz; application=naive/spill-noopt mean-plane E2E ns/op. P175/P200 are directory pressure, not L3 pressure. GM within TC then across TC; Delta uses AM then AM. Oversized reference is not Formal IdealDir.

charts.name: ubcc-metric2-reductions
charts.metric_definition: 2026-09-07 single round, 21 runs; naive/optimized speedup. TC140 visible but excluded from GM and formal applicable-case AM reduction.
